verdict.rationale: Anthropic's Commercial Terms state it 'may not train models on Customer Content from Services', and the API data-retention docs say retained data is never used for training without express permission. Consumer users also get a documented model-training setting they can switch off for new chats and coding sessions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the opt-out and no-training terms hold in practice, and opting out does not remove data from training that has already started.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Anthropic may not train models on Customer Content from Services.
Retained data is never used for model training without your express permission.
If you decide to turn off the model training setting, we will not use any new chats and coding sessions you have with Claude for future model training.
